facts.fact: Namibia's Ministry of Information and Communication Technology, with the ministries of Benin, Kenya, Nigeria and Togo, announced the pan-African ATLAS Umoja AI initiative on African language AI at the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja, and its minister committed to support it; the document names no signed agreement.

systems.system: Abuja Ministerial Declaration on Meaningful Connectivity for Africa

note: Namibia is not named as a signatory of the Abuja Declaration; only the ATLAS Umoja launch names it.
